messages:
olivia: Heads-up  opened a small PR to clean up rate-limit and quota examples across the pricing pages. https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/docs/pulls/1204
sam: Thanks. Can we also standardize the header name? I keep seeing `X-Quota-Tier` and `x-org-quota` mixed in examples. Recommend canonical: `x-redwood-quota`.
mina: Agreed. Also found a stale link in the analytics section pointing at the old dashboard slug. I'll update that in a follow-up to keep this PR focused.
olivia: Plan: (1) replace legacy header names in JS/Python/Go snippets, (2) add a tiny migration note showing client-level vs call-level header usage, (3) include a one-line FAQ about burst credits and sudden unit-cost dips. Leaving grafana panel rename to @mina.
sam: For the migration snippet, could be two short examples like:

```js
// client-level header
const client = new Redwood({ headers: { 'x-redwood-quota': 'tier-pro' } })
await client.usage.list({ limit: 5 })

// call-level override
await client.usage.list({ limit: 5 }, { headers: { 'x-redwood-quota': 'partner-B' } })
```

mina: Nice. Also add a 429 handling example for the JS sample (exponential backoff + respect Retry-After). Folks keep pasting naive loops.
docs-bot: Link-check queued for branch. Result: 1 failing link (analytics grafana panel). Failing URL: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/old-analytics/42. CI: https://ci.redwood.ai/links/4512
sam: LGTM for content. Once @mina updates the grafana ref and we re-run link checks we can merge.
mina: I'll open the small follow-up PR for the grafana panel and translations for the new header string.
olivia: Pushed the header renames + migration snippets + FAQ bullet. Targeting merge after grafana follow-up checks are green. Thanks! :thumbsup:
